name: Arvind Limited
summary: Arvind Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, retails, supplies, and exports textiles in India and internationally. The company operates through Textiles, Advanced Material, and Others segments. It offers denim fabrics, woven and knitted fabrics, home linens, and voiles and garments products, as well as ready-to-wear apparel and custom tailoring.
